sloka: पट्टिशेन शिताग्रेण प्रघसः प्रत्ययोधयत् ।भासकर्णश्च शूलेन राक्षसः कपिसत्तमम् ।। ५.४६.३३।।।।
transliteration: paṭṭiśena śitāgreṇa praghasaḥ pratyayodhayat ।bhāsakarṇaśca śūlena rākṣasaḥ kapisattamam ।। 5.46.33।।।।

translations.english: Praghasa fought back the glorious tiger among vanaras with a sharp crowbar on one side and Bhaskarana attacked with a spear from the other.
